subject: Phased MAP safeguard and request to rebaseline evaluation window
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Caleb Nguyen <caleb@northbridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP proposal — phased safeguard and evaluation window

Caleb —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a revised mutual action plan that stages the evaluation window into two checkpoints and includes optional ramp credits if the second checkpoint extends beyond the original close date. The core ask from your side was a short-term rebaseline so the internal network test and SOC evidence reviews can finish without holding up the pilot.

Highlights: 
- Split evaluation into Phase 1 (functional + latency checks, 2 weeks) and Phase 2 (security + integration, 3 weeks).
- Conditional credit: 10% service credit applied to first month if Phase 2 extends the close date > 14 days.
- Shipping a minimal SOC2 artifacts bundle for review (we'll add customer-specific logs on request).

Attachment: NB_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps: If you agree to the phased approach we'll propose the formal rebaseline language and loop legal for a short addendum. Laura and Neha are on copy for implementation details.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
From: Caleb Nguyen <caleb@northbridge.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.io
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — phased safeguard and evaluation window

Priyom —

Thanks for turning this around quickly. The phased approach looks sensible. Two small asks from our side before we sign:

1) We need a guarantee that the Phase 1 handoff won't be used to delay Phase 2 indefinitely — a simple calendar-based trigger for Phase 2 start would help.
2) Our procurement team is asking for a capped credit alternative rather than an open-ended SLA credit — can we do a firm cap and an expiration window?

If you can send the rebaseline language and the capped credit proposal, I can route to our procurement and security teams this afternoon.

—Caleb
Director, Cloud Programs
NorthBridge Systems

On Tue, Sep 9, 2025 at 9:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Caleb —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday...
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Caleb Nguyen <caleb@northbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP proposal — phased safeguard and evaluation window

Team — looping in the legal play and a short implementation note. Draft approach to address Caleb's asks:

1) Trigger: Phase 2 will automatically open 14 days after Phase 1 completion unless NorthBridge explicitly opts to delay (we'll require a recorded request). That forces a calendar-based start but keeps flexibility.
2) Capped credit: propose a single credit capped at $15k or 15% of the initial month (whichever is lower), applicable if Phase 2 completion extends the signed close date by >14 calendar days.

Neha: can you confirm we can support the two-phase onboarding schedule operationally and whether the credit mechanics are implementable (billing offset or invoice credit)?
Rachel: can you draft a one-page addendum with these triggers and the credit cap? We should keep it simple — procurement is sensitive to open-ended credits.

If we align today I can send the addendum to Caleb and procurement by EOD.

Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Caleb Nguyen <caleb@northbridge.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, procurement@northbridge.io
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP proposal — phased safeguard and evaluation window (addendum attached)

Caleb —

Attached is a one-page addendum that captures: the Phase 1/Phase 2 calendar trigger, the capped credit ($15,000 or 15% floor), and simple acceptance criteria per phase (functional sign-off for Phase 1; security artifacts + integration smoke tests for Phase 2). We kept the language intentionally prescriptive to avoid back-and-forth between legal teams.

Attachment: extension_terms_draft.pdf (pdf)

If you approve, sign or countersign and we will arrange a quick kickoff meeting with Neha to lock dates in the MAP tracker.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

---
From: Caleb Nguyen <caleb@northbridge.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.io
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — phased safeguard and evaluation window (addendum attached)

Rachel / Priyom —

This looks reasonable. Procurement gave the green light on the capped credit and the automatic Phase 2 trigger. I signed the addendum on our side and uploaded it to our DocuSign queue. Please confirm once you receive the countersigned copy. Also, let’s schedule the Phase 1 kickstart for Monday (14 Sep) at 10am PT — Neha, can your team host?

Appreciate the responsiveness.

—Caleb
Director, Cloud Programs
NorthBridge Systems

Caleb — thanks, great to have alignment.

Neha: we are confirmed for kickoff Monday 14 Sep, 10am PT. I'll put a calendar invite and link to the shared MAP tracker (see HubSpot link below). Laura, Rachel — I will follow up on countersign and confirm after DocuSign completes.

Thanks team — moving this back on-track.

Priyom Das
